note: Pinned local classifier artifacts. Weights are downloaded at install time and verified against these hashes; none are committed. Accuracy is measured by `promptvpn eval`, see docs/evaluation.md.

gliner-pii-edge.purpose: Span-level PII recognition through the embedded ONNX runtime (not Ollama)
gliner-pii-edge.runtime: onnxruntime 1.20 via gline-rs 1.1.0 (vendored, patched for ModernBERT); token-level mode

qwen3guard.purpose: Generative guard classifier (prompt moderation, PII category, owner concepts as extra categories)
qwen3guard.invocation: raw /api/generate with the model's official prompt-moderation template built by Prompt VPN; temperature 0
qwen3guard.notes: No official Ollama package exists. Ordinary qwen3:0.6b is NOT a substitute; identity is checked by weight blob sha256.

lfm3.purpose: Semantic concept classifier with JSON-schema constrained output
lfm3.license: LFM Open License v1.0 (commercial use licensed only below USD 10M annual revenue)
lfm3.notes: lfm3:1.7b is a multi-platform manifest list: Apple Silicon resolves to an MLX nvfp4 safetensors build (identity = pinned platform manifest digest from /api/tags); other platforms resolve to the GGUF Q4_K_M (identity = pinned weight blob sha256). The explicit GGUF tag lfm3:1.7b-q4_K_M needs Ollama newer than 0.40.12.
